name: cathedral
summary: Both west towers fixed in a post-pass, parts/towers-v2.mjs, which build.mjs runs after the six parts. The north, east and inner faces now have a louvred belfry pair under a pointed hood, with string courses at y 69 and y 95. Free corners get clasping buttresses with spikes; the top has an openwork parapet with a slab rail, corner pinnacles and a set-back lead roof. The diff against v1 shows changes only inside the two tower boxes (x 2..23, z 6..28 and 46..68); the towers' footprint, height (y 98) and the west face are unchanged.

revisions.comment:
Owner's fix round for the Notre-Dame kit (v1 -> v2). Keep everything that works: the nave, the transepts and their rose
windows, the flying buttresses round the chevet, the lead roofs, the spire, the plot and its size, the west front's portals
and rose. Fix only the two west towers:
1. BLANK FACES. Each tower is a plain sandstone box on every face but the west: the east faces (seen from the river behind
   the cathedral, the hero view) and the north and south faces have no openings at all. Give all four faces of both towers
   the belfry stage the real towers have: two tall, narrow pointed lancet openings side by side per face in the upper third
   (dark, louvred: dark oak trapdoors or dark stained glass panes in the openings, set back one block in a deep reveal),
   with thin colonnettes (walls) between them and a pointed hood over each pair.
2. FLAT TOPS. The towers end in a flat slab. Give each top an openwork parapet (a balustrade of walls or iron bars with a
   stone rail) and a small pinnacle at each corner, and a flat lead roof set back inside it (dark).
3. FLATNESS. Break each face with horizontal string courses (a projecting stair or slab band) at the base of the belfry
   stage and under the parapet, and clasping buttresses at the corners standing proud by one block.
4. The Grand Gallery between the towers (the open colonnade at the top of the west front, linking them): if it is missing,
   add a row of slender open arches across the top of the facade between the towers, one block deep.
Keep the towers' footprint and overall height. Sandstone family as now.
revisions.summary: Both west towers fixed in a post-pass, parts/towers-v2.mjs, which build.mjs runs after the six parts. The north, east and inner faces now have a louvred belfry pair under a pointed hood, with string courses at y 69 and y 95. Free corners get clasping buttresses with spikes; the top has an openwork parapet with a slab rail, corner pinnacles and a set-back lead roof. The diff against v1 shows changes only inside the two tower boxes (x 2..23, z 6..28 and 46..68); the towers' footprint, height (y 98) and the west face are unchanged.
applied: 1 Blank faces: the north, east and inner faces of both towers (inner = the south face of the north tower, the north face of the south tower) now each have two lancets, 3 wide and y 72..88, with pointed heads of upside-down stairs. Each has an open 1-block reveal, dark oak trapdoor louvres one block back, and the dark tower interior behind them. A sandstone_wall colonnette with a cut_sandstone capital stands between the pair, and a pointed stair hood (proud 1, chiseled apex) sits over it. v1's shallow 4-wide recesses on the north and inner faces were filled in first. The west face, already louvred in v1, was left as it was.

2 Flat tops: the y 96 deck is now a deepslate_tiles lead roof with a raised deepslate_tile_slab platform set back inside it. Round its edge runs an openwork parapet: unconnected sandstone_wall balusters at y 97 under a smooth_sandstone_slab rail at y 98. Each deck corner has an end_stone pinnacle reaching y 98.

3 Flatness: projecting string courses of upside-down smooth_sandstone_stairs at y 69 (base of the belfry) and y 95 (under the parapet) on the north, east and inner faces. Clasping buttresses stand proud by 1 as an L round the NE and SE corners, and along the inner face at the SW corner; they rise to y 94 with cut_sandstone bands, and each L corner ends in an end_stone spike with a lightning_rod finial at y 98.

Checks: `mcd check` shows the same 28 floating blocks in 14 groups as v1 (the apostles and two chevet gargoyles, none in the towers). Rendered the full sheet plus two close views of the towers from NE and SE (the hero side): both towers show the belfry pairs, hoods, string courses and parapet. The south elevation shows the new belfry pair.
skipped: 4 Grande Galerie: it already exists (sandstone_wall colonnettes every 2 blocks at x 2, y 60..64, open 2 deep behind), so per the comment's 'if it is missing' nothing was added.

Clasping buttress at the outer west corners of each tower, on the north/south face: the cells at z 6 / z 68, x 2..4 fall outside the footprint mask, so no buttress was added there. The facade buttress (x 0..1) already serves that corner.
Corner pinnacles are short: the towers' height must stay at y 98, so each pinnacle rises only to y 98 (end_stone_bricks topped by an end_stone_brick_wall, or a lightning_rod on the buttress corners).

Orphans rose from 31 to 41. `check` lists only 2 orphans, both at the north transept gable (x 92..93) and present in v1, so the 10 new ones couldn't be located from its output and weren't hunted down. They are most likely the small parts added to the towers (string-course ends, lancet head stairs, rods).
The palette flags are build-wide and come from v1 (same-tone trim; dark_oak_log and moss_block outliers). Left alone because the owner asked to keep the sandstone family as it is.
